'''''Convolvulus cneorum''''', the '''silverbush''' or '''shrubby bindweed''',<ref name = RHSPF /> is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Convolvulaceae]], which contains many plants described as "bindweed". The Latin [[binomial nomenclature|specific epithet]] ''cneorum'' is a word of Greek origin referring to a small olive-like plant, possibly a species of [[Daphne (plant)|''Daphne'']].<ref name=RHSLG>{{cite book |last=Harrison |first=Lorraine |title=RHS Latin for Gardeners |year=2012 |publisher=Mitchell Beazley |location=United Kingdom |isbn=978-1845337315 }}</ref>

==Description==
Unlike other species in the [[genus]], it is an [[evergreen]] [[shrub]] rather than a [[vine]], forming a low mound {{convert|0.6|-|1.2|m|0|abbr=on}} in height, with a similar spread. It produces many pink buds unfurling to white {{convert|2.5|-|4|cm|0|abbr=on}} diameter flowers which are white with a yellow throat. These appear at the end of stems in loose [[panicles]] and may almost completely cover the plants for a long period from spring to the summer months. The [[leaf|leaves]] are grey-green and are covered in fine hairs which give the plant a silvery appearance.<ref name=irish>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Be8KS9uok7cC&q=convolvulus+cneorum+distribution&pg=PA119|author=Irish, M.| title=Perennials for the Southwest: Plants That Flourish in Arid Gardens| publisher=Timber Press|location= United States |isbn=978-0-88192-761-0|pages=314|date=2006-02-06}}</ref>

==Distribution==
The species is found in coastal areas of Spain, Italy, Croatia and Albania.<ref name = irish/> In Italy it is found on the coast of Tuscany and western Sicily and on the islands of Capri and Li Galli. In Croatia it is found on many of the islands off the coast. It is often found growing in cracks in rocks.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Pandza |first=M.  |date=March 2002 |title= Localities of the species ''Convolvulus cneorum'' L. (Convolvulacae in Croatia|journal=Natura Croatica |volume=11 |issue=1 |pages=113–118 |issn= 1330-0520 |url=https://hrcak.srce.hr/clanak/17632 |access-date= 2007-12-08 }}</ref>

==Cultivation==
The species prefers an [[alkaline]] soil, full sun and good drainage. It tolerates near-drought conditions for short periods,<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.gardenia.net/plant/convolvulus-cneorum-shrubby-bindweed-1 | title = Convolvulus cneorum | publisher = Gardenia.net | access-date = 16 September 2019}}</ref> and is cold hardy to −9 C.<ref name = irish/> It has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]]<ref name = RHSPF>{{cite web 
| url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/4333/i-Convolvulus-cneorum-i/Details
| title = RHS Plantfinder – ''Convolvulus cneorum''
| access-date = 30 January 2018}}</ref> (confirmed 2017).<ref>{{cite web  | url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf | title = AGM Plants – Ornamental | date = July 2017 | page = 22 | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | access-date = 24 January 2018}}</ref>
